1.

Behold, with clouds He descends, He who once was crucified! Ransomed hosts follow Him, Give glory with a song of victory, Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Rejoice throughout eternity long.

2.

Israel shall behold Him Full of grace and majesty, See the Son of God, whom they rejected, Mocked, smote, hanged upon the tree, Their Messiah, Their Messiah, They in glory’s splendor now see.

3.

Behold, the marks of the nails He bears in glory; The theme for full worship The redemption work is, Hallelujah! Hallelujah! God renders reward to the Lamb.

4.

“Come,” thus the Spirit says, “Come,” thus also says thy bride. Come shalt Thou, Lord Jesus, Clad in glory’s robe, Thou hast won Thou hast won Eternal glory for thy God.
